name: Amplia DC0
notes: Commercial directory sources list Amplia DC0 at Hingoo Road and El Socorro Extension South, San Juan, and identify Amplia/Massy Communications as the operator. No public capacity found.

name: Barataria Trinidad Data Centre
notes: Uptime Institute lists Fujitsu Caribbean as client for Barataria Trinidad Data Centre in Barataria, Trinidad and Tobago; Data Center Map places it at Sixth Ave Ext & Ibis Ave, San Juan. Fujitsu customer story confirms use of Fujitsu's Tier III Data Center in Trinidad.

name: TSTT / E-IDCOT Tobago Tier III Data Centre at Cove Estate
notes: 2017 plan for Tobago's first Tier III data centre at the Cove Estate Eco-Industrial and Business Park; Trinidad Guardian reported on 2026-07-18 that the project had been shelved/unplugged. E-IDCOT still has a data-centre page for Cove Tobago but without evidence of operation.

name: TSTT Mausica Data Centre
developer: Telecommunications Services of Trinidad and Tobago (TSTT)
notes: TSTT official page confirms its certified data centre; Mapcarta identifies TSTT Mausica Data Center on Mausica Road in Tunapuna/Piarco, and Tech News TT identifies TSTT's other data centre as Mausica. TSTT states TIA-942-B Rated 3, DCOS maturity level 3, and SOC Type 2 certifications.
